plugins.name: 90north-develop
plugins.description: North's development plugin: n-defect-loop (defects: reproduce → root cause → test-first fix → PR → QA lane) and n-develop-loop (features and changes: acceptance red → design → test-first build → PR → review lane), the same 9 steps in each, attended or unattended with --auto; only low-impact changes inside a standing approval merge on their own. On the n-dev discipline, with n-arch capturing each repo's architecture rules, for any repo — on Jira or on a local board of markdown cards when there is no Jira.
